latest_release.name: v3.12.0
latest_release.body: 3.12.0 adds seven themes, a text size setting, and gain and loss colours for markets where red means up. The phone app now keeps a stack of screens for each tab, the dashboard and Insights share one time period, and a rebalancing worksheet works out adjustments from your allocation target. Fund conversions, new price sources and AI agent access to Spending round it out, with fixes across spending, goals, performance, import and mobile. ## Highlights - **Themes.** Seven new themes join Classic: Signature, Ember, Cupertino, Newspaper, Cyber, Terminal and Poster. Pick one in Settings → Appearance or during setup. The theme is saved per device; new profiles start on Signature and existing ones keep Classic. Charts follow the theme, and Classic's charts now use softer colours. (#2305, #2360, #2361) - **Text size.** Settings → Appearance → Text size: Small, Default, Large or Extra large, on this device. On iPhone and Android the app starts from the system text size. (#2323) - **Gain and loss colours.** Choose Red up, green down or Red up, blue down, as in China, Taiwan, South Korea and Japan. Green up stays the default. (#2326) - **Phone navigation.** Each tab of the bottom bar keeps its own stack of screens, so going back returns to the screen as you left it. Swipe from the left edge to go back on iPhone; Android's Back button steps back through the tab. Holdings joins the bar, which is a full-width Material bar on Android. (#2287, #2290, #2295, #2384) - **One time period.** The period you pick on the dashboard or in Insights carries over to the other tabs, and Investments and Net Worth get Spending's calendar picker. (#2285) - **Rebalancing worksheet.** It replaces the Rebalance planner: open a target's details and choose **Open rebalancing**. Pick the cash to deploy, accounts and eligible securities, adjust the suggested trades, then copy or export them. Nothing is executed. (#1612) - **Fund conversions.** Record a fund switch, a share-class conversion or a fund-to-ETF conversion as **Fund conversion**: the new units keep the old ones' cost and dates, and nothing is sold. (#2336) - **More price sources.** A provider catalog in Settings → Market data, with **AMFI** for Indian mutual funds and the **Moscow Exchange**, both off until you add them. Custom providers get a TMX Money template and POST requests. (#2367, #2356, #2365, #2380, #2386, #1800, #1916) - **Spending for AI agents.** Three new permissions, View spending, Organize spending and Manage budgets, let an agent read and organize your spending and budgets. Changes are shown for review before they're saved. (#2251, #2296) - **Retirement and savings goals share accounts.** A savings goal can take part of an account Retirement uses; the retirement chart marks each goal. (#2398) ## Upgrading - Nothing is recalculated on first launch, and existing profiles keep their look (Classic and Mono). (#2361) - **AI agent access:** existing tokens keep exactly their permissions. An agent that used the categorization tools needs View spending, plus Organize spending to make changes: edit the token in Settings → AI agent access and reconnect the agent. **Activities — commit/write** now also allows deleting and voiding activities. (#2135, #2296) - **Synced devices:** update them all before you change gain and loss colours, record a fund conversion, or let a savings goal share an account with Retirement. Devices still on 3.11 don't handle them correctly. If one received a conversion while on 3.11, open that account after updating and choose **Recalculate History**. detail.readme_excerpt:
Wealthfolio

The open-source, private portfolio tracker — investments, net worth, spending, and simulations.
Local-first: your data lives on your device.

Website · Discord · Twitter · Releases

⬇️  Download for macOS · Windows · Linux  ·  📱 iOS App  ·  🤖 Android App  ·  🐳 Docker

[](https://www.buymeacoffee.com/afadil)
## Introduction **Wealthfolio** is an open-source, private portfolio tracker — investments, net worth, spending, and simulations. All your data is stored locally on your device: no cloud database, no account required, free forever. For automatic brokerage syncing (30+ institutions, read-only) and encrypted multi-device sync, there's **[Wealthfolio Connect](https://wealthfolio.app/connect?utm_source=github&utm_medium=readme)** — an optional subscription that covers the real cost of the brokerage data connections.
